title: Code Mod Kit TypeID alias-binding import cleanup repair
head: 12b865fa50b34fec23d54cebbc8a73d0348b80c9

defect.failure: The migration keyed removable imports by module specifier plus exported name. removeNamedImport then removed every alias of that export, including a separately aliased binding with surviving references.
defect.failureScenario: Two imports of canonical ChatId use local names MigratedChatId and SurvivingChatId. brandedId<MigratedChatId>() is migrated while export type Keep = SurvivingChatId remains. The old cleanup removed both import specifiers and broke Keep.

repair.architecture: Code Mod Kit now exposes removeNamedImportBinding, which targets the module specifier, exported name, and exact local binding name. The TypeID codemod returns one binding-specific removal only when every reference to that local binding is inside a replaced call.

red.result: 1 failed, 4 passed; apply refused after broad removal broke the surviving alias

focusedCodemod.result: 2 files, 15 tests pass; alias fixture has 0 post-emit diagnostics
